Name: Dino Nugget Ranch
Author: TheRedStarfish
Description:
[size=4]Mod Details
[/size]﻿
Dino Nugget Ranch adds dinosaur nuggets as new purchasable barn animals from Marnie!

There are 3 possible variants:
[list]
[*]Brontosaurus Nugget
[*]Stegosaurus Nugget
[*]﻿Tyrannosaurus Rex Nugget
[/list]
They take 5 days to grow into adults, and then produce Dino Nugget Eggs every 3 days.
The eggs can be turned into Dino Nugget Mayonnaise or hatched in an ostrich incubator.
There's also a new recipe to learn!



[size=4]How to Install
[/size][list]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Install Content Patcher
[*]Download and unzip this mod, then add it to your mods folder
[*]Done!
[/list]



A huge thank you to the wonderful and patient people on the Stardew Valley and East Scarp discords!
